title: Compact route-audit stream with adaptive watermarks & hop-echo metrics
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Our current routing observability either emits full decision traces (high fidelity, high cardinality, high cost) or tiny metrics (low cost, low context). We need a middle-ground that preserves root-cause signals for multi-hop routing (region selection, tier routing, model-variant fallback) while keeping storage & query costs predictable for long-term SLO and incident workflows.

Goal: Implement a compact route-audit stream that emits a single compact event per request summarizing per-hop condensed metrics plus an optional sampled full snapshot. The stream should: 1) support adaptive sampling via "watermarks" (higher sampling when latency or error exceeds percentiles), 2) include a hop-echo section with micro metrics per hop (latency_ms, model_variant, tier, region, kv_cache_hit), 3) be queryable for common RCA patterns (fallback frequency by region, tier degradation, model-variant regressions), and 4) integrate with existing tracing (trace_id) and console dashboards.

Scope: schema design, producer instrumentation in routing layer, adaptive watermark sampling service, storage pipeline changes (Kafka -> transform -> compressed column store), queryable dashboards & alerting rules, cost estimate and rollout plan.

Acceptance criteria: Compact events reduce per-request telemetry size by >=6x vs full trace, alerting queries for top-10 routes run under 10s, sampled full snapshots available for at least 1 in 10K requests under normal conditions and up to 1 in 1K during anomalies, and there is a documented migration for downstream consumers.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Define compact event schema and confirm with Console, Runtime and SRE.
2) Implement producer in routing layer that emits compact events plus probabilistic full snapshots.
3) Implement adaptive watermark sampler that raises sampling when latency or fallback rate crosses configured percentiles per route.
4) Transform pipeline applies LZ4 compression + field deduplication; end-to-end test proves >=6x size reduction vs current full trace.
5) Dashboard cards for fallback frequency, per-hop median P50/P95 latency, and model-variant fallback trends.
6) Run 2-week canary in us-west-2 on 10% traffic with rollback playbook.
7) Observability docs and OpenAPI for compact event schema published.
telemetry_schema: Each compact_event includes: decision_id, trace_id, timestamp, request_route, route_version, final_decision, fallback_reason (if any), total_latency_ms, total_token_estimate, hop_echo (list of compact hop tuples: hop_index|region|tier|model_variant|latency_ms|kv_cache_hit|exec_tokens), sampling_reason (normal|watermark_high_latency|watermark_high_fallback|manual), sampling_rate_applied, env (prod|staging), tags (list). Note: hop_echo is encoded as a compressed CSV string to keep event flat for downstream processors.
storage_estimate: Projected ingestion: 120M requests/day -> compact_event avg 480 bytes -> 54.2 GB/day raw -> LZ4 compression factor 3x -> ~18 GB/day. Sampled full snapshots: baseline 1/10k -> ~1.2k/day @ 10KB = 12MB/day. Monthly billable storage ~540 GB/month (retention 30d) with queryable indices for trace_id and route_version.
comments: 2025-01-12 Maya Chen: Draft schema posted in Confluence. Asked Console team to confirm dashboard wireframes; awaiting feedback.

2025-01-16 Diego Alvarez: Implemented producer stub in routing v2 branch; added compact CSV encoder for hop_echo. Performance microbench shows ~1% extra p95 latency when batching writes to async pipeline.
2025-01-20 Priya Singh (SRE): Reviewed storage estimate. Suggested adding a watermark multiplier per-tenant to avoid bursty spikes from heavy tenants.

2025-01-28 Diego Alvarez: Adaptive watermark prototype implemented. Sampling rules: baseline 1/10k, if route P95 > route_config.watermark_latency -> sample_rate *= 8 (up to 1/1k); similarly for fallback rate triggers. Integration tests added.
2025-01-31 Product review: PM (Alex Wu) asked for a fallback-focused alert that surfaces model-variant regressions by region. Added to acceptance criteria and dashboard backlog.
2025-02-04 Security review: quick sync concluded no PII in compact events, encryption in-transit sufficient. Will surface to security process if adding request payload samples.
2025-02-05 Diego Alvarez: Began canary rollout plan docs. Need final sign-off from Runtime on the CSV encoding and from Console on the index fields.
blockers: Console needs to confirm which fields are indexed (trace_id vs decision_id) to finalize transform schema
